Hello Malaysia Project

About Us

A cross-disciplinary team of students building one digital platform to present Malaysia's tourism, culture, nature, culinary heritage, and inspiring figures in a clear and modern way.

Meet The Team

At A Glance

30 Members
5 Departments
6 Content Pages

We combine engineering, design, finance, culinary, and hospitality perspectives to create a richer storytelling experience.

Who We Are

We are a collaborative student team with one mission: transform information about Malaysia into a digital experience that is easy to navigate, visually engaging, and meaningful for learners and visitors.

  • Built with shared ownership across all departments.
  • Designed to balance storytelling and clarity.
  • Focused on consistency across every section page.

How We Work

  1. Research each topic and define content priorities.
  2. Create wireframes and visual direction together.
  3. Implement, review, and refine page-by-page.

Clarity First

We structure content so visitors can understand core ideas quickly.

Creative Direction

Visual style is crafted intentionally to avoid generic section pages.

Team Collaboration

Every department contributes expertise to keep the project balanced.
